lines.says: the elbows open to near straight at the top and close to about a right angle or less at the bottom
lines.open: #202: provisional. The owner tuned the top of the rep soft, about 27° of bend, against their note of straight arms; their morning look says which they want.

lines.says: the hips stay on the pad
the head stays on the pad
the shoulders stay pinned to the pad
the bar travels on a near-straight line, chest to over the shoulders
the upper arms keep their angle to the trunk: no tuck and flare mid-rep
lines.open: #196 has this lift live with the owner. The upper arm tucks to 51° mid-rep, between 91° and 80°, and the elbow swings 18 cm toward the feet and back.

lines.says: the hand's roll runs evenly through the rep
at the bottom the forearms stand upright under the bar
at the bottom the bar touches the lower chest
at the top the bar stands over the shoulders
